Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.sms

package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.sms
SMS adapter of the authorization server: the logging default sender with its bounded outbox, the Twilio and Amazon SNS gateways (each enabled by its own profile) and the libphonenumber normaliser.
  • Class
    Description
    LibPhoneNumberCountryResolver
    PhoneCountryResolver over libphonenumber: the region of an E.164 number.
    LibPhoneNumberNormalizer
    PhoneNormalizer backed by Google libphonenumber: accepts only valid numbers and never throws.
    LoggingSmsSender
    Default SmsSender: sends nothing, it records the message in the SmsOutbox and logs the masked recipient.
    MissingSmsGatewayConfiguration
    Stops the startup when no SMS gateway is configured: none of the profiles that provide an SmsSender (twilio, sns, or dev / test for the logging one) is active.
    SentSms
    A text message recorded by the SmsOutbox.
    SmsAdapterConfiguration
    Wires the phone normaliser and the logging SmsSender of development and tests.
    SmsOutbox
    Bounded, thread-safe, in-memory record of the messages the LoggingSmsSender "sent", so the development inbox can show them, which reads it through the domain port SmsInbox.
    SmsOutboxProperties
    Settings of the SmsOutbox.
    SnsConfiguration
    Wires the Amazon SNS sender when the sns profile is active.
    SnsSmsSender
    SmsSender that publishes directly to a phone number through Amazon SNS.
    TwilioConfiguration
    Wires the Twilio sender when the twilio profile is active (and SNS is not, so that never two SmsSender beans exist).
    TwilioMessageClient
    Thin wrapper over the Twilio SDK, so the sender can be unit-tested with a mock.
    TwilioProperties
    Twilio credentials and sender, bound from the environment variables AUTHSERVER_SMS_TWILIO_* only; no value is ever written in a file of this repository.
    TwilioSmsSender
    SmsSender that sends through Twilio.
